display_name: Select the cheapest (model, effort) that clears a capability score
description: Given required_score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index scale, returns the cheapest accepted and fresh catalog cell that clears the score plus margin. dispatch_kind is provenance only; capability floors named by scope_tags are the only policy pair restriction. Quota readings from usage_economics.v1.json exclude exhausted vendors and exclude unknown quota states fail-closed, permitting a cheaper cross-vendor fallback when one is exhausted. The answer is an exact cost argmin with a selection_receipt that spawn_session replays before dispatch. Refuses rather than guesses: catalog_empty, catalog_stale, quota_state_unknown, no_cell_clears_threshold, parameter_invalid.
embedding_description: Choosing which AI model and reasoning-effort setting to assign a piece of work so that it is capable enough for the job at the lowest cost, with the reasoning shown and a refusal when the price and score data are too old.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: selected (runtime, model, effort, capability_score, cost_per_task_usd, relative_cost_multiplier, measured_at, acceptance), billing_objective, required_score, effective_required_score, frontier, dominated, ladder, excluded counts, catalog_run_id, policy_version, unscored_cells, selection_receipt.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Name the selected model and effort with its score and cost, then the next cheapest frontier alternative. If the ladder shows a near-zero points_per_cost_unit step, say that raising effort on this model buys little. Do not restate every excluded count unless asked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass selected.runtime, selected.model, selected.effort, required_score as difficulty_score, and selection_receipt unchanged to spawn_session or dispatch_managed_work. A no_cell_clears_threshold refusal means the ask exceeds available capability; do not pick by hand.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One catalog read plus an in-memory selection; the dispatch policy JSON is loaded when dispatch_kind is given. No writes, no network.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_stale: no cell is both accepted and inside its staleness window, so nothing may be served. catalog_empty: the catalog was never seeded. no_cell_clears_threshold: cells are fresh but none clears required_score + score_margin under the policy filter. parameter_invalid: required_score missing, an unknown billing_objective, a negative margin or tolerance, or a non-positive max_staleness_hours. dispatch_policy_violation / dispatch_policy_invalid / dispatch_policy_unavailable: the dispatch_kind or the policy file is bad. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For catalog_stale, run or wait for a refresh run that accepts cells, and check read_model_capability_catalog with include_unaccepted=true to see what is pending. For no_cell_clears_threshold, read the frontier of a lower ask to see how far the catalog reaches. Never loosen max_staleness_hours to get an answer; the verb will not allow it.
